summary: SuperTrend: a trailing line set three 10-bar ATRs from median price, green in uptrends and red in downtrends.
overview: SuperTrend draws a single trailing line on the price chart. While the trend is up, the line sits below price in green; while it is down, it sits above in red.
The line switches sides when price closes through it.
how: Basic upper band = (high + low) / 2 + 3 x ATR(10). Basic lower band = (high + low) / 2 - 3 x ATR(10). The final lower band can only rise and the upper band can only fall, while the previous close stays on the right side.
The trend turns up when the close goes above the upper band, and down when it goes below the lower band.
use: Some traders use the line as a trailing stop.
Use the color change as a sign of a trend change.
Use a higher factor for fewer flips and a lower factor for more.
Watch the distance from price to see how stretched the trend is.
alerts: Alerts: you can alert on its line crossing a value or the candle close (from the chart's + menu); checked while ZoroCharts is open.
notes: Works on any symbol and timeframe; it only needs candle data.
It can flip often in ranges.
